name: Jianghu Simulator
detailed_description:
Simulated Jianghu is a role-playing game that melds sect-management gameplay with multiple playthroughs, high player freedom, and a down-to-earth wuxia atmosphere.

[Premium Single-Player • Relaxed & Casual]

Simulated Jianghu is a paid, single-player mobile title. Designed for portrait mode, it emphasizes a laid-back experience: minimal fiddly controls, a stronger focus on story and strategy.

[Rich Game Content]

  • 100 + learnable martial-arts skills, each with its own flavor

  • A highly tactical “Inspiration” ultimate-skill system

  • 30 + recruitable story characters who can join the protagonist’s sect

  • 200 + unique special gear items

  • A wealth of random encounters, sect chores, long-journey events, and exploratory maps…

[High Freedom]

There is no fixed pacing. Explore an open world packed with branching plots and hidden secrets entirely at your own rhythm.

[Management Strategy]

Beyond personal adventure, you’ll live the jianghu life as a sect leader: handle internal affairs, train disciples, construct buildings, expand territory. Will you weave alliances among the great sects, or forge your own path even if the martial world turns against you? The choice is yours.

[Real-Time Combat]

Battles are fast and real-time, with countless tactical build variations waiting to be discovered.

[New Game Plus]

A multi-run system lets every completed journey pass down legacies that push you farther in the next playthrough.

[Multiple Scenarios]

At present we’ve finished one full scenario. Looking ahead, we plan to add more:

  • Lead different sects toward varied goals.

  • Play as a disciple and roam the jianghu under your sect’s banner.

  • Or start from scratch as a lone wanderer, experiencing the world entirely on your own terms.
